# Agent Monitor Relay MCP

Paid remote MCP for AI agent run monitoring, failure detection, tool-call incident replay, SLA receipts, and client status exports.

Website: https://agentmonitorrelay.clauxel.com/
MCP endpoint: https://agentmonitorrelay.clauxel.com/mcp
Server card: https://agentmonitorrelay.clauxel.com/server-card.json
Docs: https://github.com/clauxel/agent-monitor-relay-mcp

Use case: Track agent runs, failures, replay evidence, and SLA receipts from one MCP.
Authentication: Bearer token required for production use.
Tools: record_agent_run, detect_agent_failure, replay_tool_call_incident, issue_sla_receipt, export_client_status
